messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character dances in place, turning her body and swinging her arms and ponytail.","camera":"A static, medium-long shot at eye level keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A sleeveless black crop top with a white geometric pattern, a brown patterned belt, and loose white pants.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Long hair tied in a high ponytail with a white hair accessory.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slender build and pale skin.","scene":"A grassy field with pink cherry blossom trees, a large red torii gate, and snow-capped mountains in the background under a blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an indoor parking garage to an outdoor grassy field with cherry blossom trees, a red torii gate, and snow-capped mountains. The character's dance motion, clothing, hair, and centered medium-long framing remain broadly consistent, and the lighting now appears as outdoor daylight.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the parking-garage scene with the reference environment, including its lighting on the person, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved exactly across all frames.
unexpected_changes: The character's face and expression are less clearly visible in several output frames, making exact expression preservation difficult to verify.
